.. py:class:: StageInputSpec

   One layer or on-disk input required by a pipeline stage.


   .. py:attribute:: slot
      :type:  str

      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: optional
      :type:  bool
      :value: False



   .. py:attribute:: from_stage
      :type:  str | None
      :value: None



.. py:class:: PipelineStageSpec

   One selectable stage in a GUI pipeline (id, display label, description, default on/off, and
   required inputs).


   .. py:attribute:: id
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: label
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: description
      :type:  str
      :value: ''



   .. py:attribute:: default_enabled
      :type:  bool
      :value: True



   .. py:attribute:: inputs
      :type:  tuple[StageInputSpec, Ellipsis]
      :value: ()



.. py:class:: PipelineStageDef

   A whole GUI pipeline: its CLI command, display title, and ordered stage specs.


   .. py:attribute:: cli_command
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: title
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: stages
      :type:  tuple[PipelineStageSpec, Ellipsis]


   .. py:attribute:: hidden_params
      :type:  frozenset[str]


.. py:class:: StageInputBinding

   A user's chosen source (Napari layer or on-disk) for one stage input slot.

      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: input_name
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: source
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: layer_name

      :value: None

.. py:function:: pipeline_def_for_script(script_name: str) -> PipelineStageDef | None

   Look up the registered :class:`PipelineStageDef` for a CLI *script_name*, or ``None``.


.. py:function:: visible_stage_inputs(stages: tuple[PipelineStageSpec, Ellipsis], enabled: dict[str, bool], stage_index: int) -> tuple[str, Ellipsis]

   Return UI keys for inputs that still need a Napari layer selection.


.. py:function:: resolve_stage_input_bindings(stages: tuple[PipelineStageSpec, Ellipsis], enabled: dict[str, bool], *, active_layer_name: str | None, layer_selections: dict[tuple[str, str], str | None]) -> list[StageInputBinding]

   Resolve how each checked stage obtains its layer inputs.


.. py:function:: binding_requires_layer(stages: tuple[PipelineStageSpec, Ellipsis], binding: StageInputBinding) -> bool

   True when a layer dropdown must be filled before running.


.. py:function:: input_label_for_key(stages: tuple[PipelineStageSpec, Ellipsis], key: str) -> str
